chosen.premise: When hunger drives Golbat to bite a Steel-type, it can lose some of its own fangs.
chosen.hook: Golbat once bit the wrong Pokémon—and paid with its teeth.
chosen.visualIdea: Follow fang marks to a Steel-type silhouette, then reveal Golbat missing teeth in the final shot.
chosen.note: An unusually concrete consequence of hunger: biting a Steel-type can cost Golbat its own fangs. The reveal is memorable and visually clear.

candidates.premise: Golbat’s fangs can puncture tough hide, but they are hollow like straws and unexpectedly fragile.
candidates.hook: Golbat’s terrifying fangs have a surprisingly obvious weakness.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom from a fang piercing thick hide to a cutaway revealing its hollow, straw-like interior.
candidates.note: The contrast between armor-piercing fangs and fragile hollow construction is highly specific, surprising, and strongly documented.

candidates.premise: Golbat can drink over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp—so much that it becomes too heavy to fly.
candidates.hook: Golbat’s biggest weakness is getting exactly what it wants.
candidates.visualIdea: Show a blood meter filling past maximum as Golbat wobbles, drops from the sky, and lands on the ground.
candidates.note: A sharply defined self-defeating feeding behavior, directly supported by multiple Pokédex entries and easy to visualize.

candidates.premise: Golbat evolves from Zubat at level 22, but reaching Crobat requires friendship at 160 instead.
candidates.hook: Golbat’s next evolution cannot be unlocked by leveling alone.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Zubat’s level counter reaching 22, then freeze Golbat while a friendship meter must climb to 160.
candidates.note: The level-22-to-friendship-160 progression is concrete and game-readable, but friendship evolution is not exclusive to Golbat.

candidates.premise: Golbat’s feet are tiny, yet it can walk skillfully to sneak up on sleeping prey.
candidates.hook: Golbat looks built to fly—but its tiny feet can still hunt on the ground.
candidates.visualIdea: Contrast Golbat’s enormous wings with tiny feet, then animate silent footsteps approaching sleeping prey.
candidates.note: A strong physical contradiction with clear animation potential, though less distinctive and consequential than the fang or feeding angles.

candidates.premise: Despite feasting on blood, Golbat sometimes shares what it gathers when others of its kind are hungry.
candidates.hook: Golbat is a blood-drinker with one unexpectedly generous habit.
candidates.visualIdea: Show a solitary Golbat drinking, then pivot to it returning and sharing the collected blood with hungry Golbat.
candidates.note: The generosity twist is excellent, but the cited evidence directly supports sharing only in one entry; the other citations establish blood-drinking rather than the full premise.
